workload.query_validation: all canonical query records must contain finite Float32 values

correctness.performance_requires: strictly validated 20-case ledger bound to matching clean source, binary, numerical-build, configuration, and dataset SHA-256 identities

sampling.uncertainty_method: deterministic percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples, 95% median interval

timing_boundaries.CPU-E2E-RAW: wall time around the CPU Float32 production call on an already-loaded AoS prefix and query
timing_boundaries.BND-E2E-RAW: wall time around the CUDA one-shot production API on an already-loaded host AoS prefix and query
timing_boundaries.BND-KERNEL: CUDA events around the complete production kernel sequence

acceptance: measurement output is valid-unreviewed until environment and telemetry analysis emits accepted experiment evidence
historical_evidence_policy: S7 and S8 evidence is immutable and not replaced by S10
